summary: Audit of 'Very_Bad_Requirements_Sample.pdf': The uploaded document represents an early-stage or very low-quality requirement draft (88 words). It contains highly ambiguous language, missing technical architecture, and lacks acceptance criteria or security definitions.

risk_factors.title: High Ambiguity & Untestable Language (Requirements Notes (Very Poor Quality))
risk_factors.description: Specification contains subjective and untestable phrasing including 'awesome', 'somehow', 'things'. Engineering teams cannot derive deterministic acceptance tests.
risk_factors.mitigation: Rewrite requirements into verifiable Gherkin syntax (Given/When/Then) with quantifiable metrics (e.g. latency, error rates).

risk_factors.title: Payment Processing & PCI-DSS Compliance Gap
risk_factors.description: Document mentions financial transactions or payments without defining PCI-DSS tokenization, webhook verification, or idempotent charge safety.
risk_factors.mitigation: Integrate certified payment gateway with client-side tokenization (e.g., Stripe Elements) and zero plain-text card data retention.

risk_factors.title: Missing Identity & Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
risk_factors.description: No formal authentication mechanisms, session management, or role permissions (Admin, User, Auditor) are defined in the document.
risk_factors.mitigation: Implement OAuth2 / JWT authentication middleware with explicit principle of least privilege enforcement.

conflicts_and_ambiguities.context: Document text contains ambiguous phrase 'awesome' without technical boundaries or SLA targets.
conflicts_and_ambiguities.suggested_resolution: Replace 'awesome' with objective, measurable performance constraints or automated QA acceptance criteria.

conflicts_and_ambiguities.context: Document text contains ambiguous phrase 'somehow' without technical boundaries or SLA targets.
conflicts_and_ambiguities.suggested_resolution: Replace 'somehow' with objective, measurable performance constraints or automated QA acceptance criteria.

conflicts_and_ambiguities.context: Document text contains ambiguous phrase 'things' without technical boundaries or SLA targets.
conflicts_and_ambiguities.suggested_resolution: Replace 'things' with objective, measurable performance constraints or automated QA acceptance criteria.

missing_sections_and_details.why_missing: Missing latency thresholds (P95 < 200ms), concurrent user targets, and database connection limits.
missing_sections_and_details.recommended_addition: Define target throughput (e.g. 500 RPS), 99.9% uptime SLA, and disaster recovery RTO/RPO.

missing_sections_and_details.why_missing: Data models, foreign key relationships, and migration strategies are unaddressed.
missing_sections_and_details.recommended_addition: Provide entity relationship diagrams (ERD) and JSON schema validation rules.
